source_recommendation_assessment: The official OWASP Top 10:2025 A03 section describes risks from vulnerable or outdated dependencies and recommends tracking direct/transitive dependency versions, regular vulnerability scanning, SBOM management, monitoring advisories, and timely upgrades. The previously cited A06:2025 Vulnerable and Outdated Components URL was invalid for the 2025 edition and has been corrected to A03:2025 Software Supply Chain Failures.
